AUROC.macro_rule: if any of 627 scenario AUROCs is undefined, prespecified macro-AUROC is undefined; no scenario exclusion
AUROC.tie_handling: half credit for tied positive-negative score pairs, matching frozen auroc implementation

BCE.aggregation: mean within each official TEST scenario, then arithmetic mean across all 627 scenarios
BCE.sample_formula: negative Bernoulli log likelihood using clipped q

F1.aggregation: mean within metric sense per scenario, then arithmetic mean of 627 scenario F1 values
F1.formula: 2TP divided by 2TP plus FP plus FN

threshold_policy.decision: p_corruption greater than or equal to frozen threshold
threshold_policy.recompute_predicted_corruption: verification only; sealed Phase-A predicted_corruption is authoritative prediction artifact
threshold_policy.source: 15 already-sealed GRAPH_VAL thresholds in Phase-A predictions
